title: The Arazzo catalogue's six specification extensions
description: `x-veredictum-cite` sits on a workflow, a step or a criterion; a criterion without one inherits its step's, and a step its workflow's. `x-veredictum-check` sits on a criterion only, for the judgements no standard Arazzo criterion can express. `x-veredictum-derive` sits on a step only, and names new step outputs, each one function of BASE OBJECT_VERSION_ID applied to one of the step's own outputs; `validate` also refuses an `of` the step does not declare and a derived name that collides with a declared output. `x-veredictum-principal` sits on a step only, and names the principal the step is sent as instead of the run's ordinary credential; a run whose party supplies no credential for that principal skips every workflow with such a step with the reason `not-declared`. `x-veredictum-scope` sits on a step only, never beside `x-veredictum-principal`, and names the scope set of the access token the step presents; a row whose scope set the party's IXIT covers with no token is skipped with the reason `not-declared`. `x-veredictum-control` sits on a workflow only, and every refusal workflow, one with a criterion `$statusCode == 400` or `$statusCode == 422`, carries one: it names the workflow whose request is the same apart from the one defect, and a refusal row whose control was not accepted in the same run is errored; `validate` refuses a control on any other workflow and one that names no workflow, the workflow itself or another refusal workflow. `validate` also checks that a citation's quote occurs, after whitespace normalization, inside the named section of the named vendored file, which no schema can state.

source.description: The vendored released file, relative to the repository root.

section.description: A top-level key or a JSON Pointer in a YAML source. In a Markdown or AsciiDoc source, the title of exactly one heading, or a path of titles joined by ` > ` in which each heading sits directly under the one before it; a title that matches more than one heading is refused.

quote.description: The sentence that assigns the expectation, copied verbatim.

report.description: The upstream-report issue in this repository that records a defect, contradiction or silence in the cited text.

level.description: The requirement level of the quote: `must` (the default) for MUST, SHALL, REQUIRED or a definition, `should` for SHOULD or RECOMMENDED. `validate` refuses a level its quote's upper-case keywords disagree with, and a quote whose only keyword is MAY or OPTIONAL. A row whose failing criteria all cite `should` is failed and advisory, and never counts against a capability.

context.description: The runtime expression the judged value is read from.
The runtime expression the judged value is read from.

to.description: The document the context must equal: a literal, or a runtime expression.

ignoring.description: RM paths ignored on both sides; `**` matches any depth.

context.description: The runtime expression the judged value is read from.

oneOf.description: The step's response body validates against the schema its operation declares for the served status and media type. It runs only where a criterion asks for it, and that criterion cites the OAS element.

control.description: The control of a refusal workflow: a `workflowId` of the same document, or `$sourceDescriptions.<name>.<workflowId>` of a `type: arazzo` source, as Arazzo 1.1.0 `dependsOn` names a workflow; a list names one control per arm of an option the refusal runs under. A control is accepted when every row of it passed or failed only advisory criteria, and a refusal row is judged when no listed control that ran was refused and at least one ran.

oneOf.description: A refusal with no twin in the catalogue yet: the open issue in this repository that tracks authoring one. Such a refusal is never judged; every row of it is errored, naming the issue.

principal.description: The principal a step is sent as: `administrative` is a principal the service authorizes for its administrative operations.

scope.description: The scope set of the access token a step presents: an OAuth 2.0 scope value, space-delimited scope tokens in any order (RFC 6749 §3.3), or `$inputs.<name>` to read it from each row. The empty string is a token with no scope.

derive.description: New step outputs by name. Each applies one function of BASE `object_version_id.adoc` to an output the same step declares, whose value has the lexical form `object_id::creating_system_id::version_tree_id`; a value of another form makes the row errored.
